items.claim: Q3 2026: Q3 2026 (three months to 30 September 2026, released 28 October 2026): revenue 104.6155 trillion won (+32% QoQ, +328% YoY; first quarter above 100 trillion won), operating profit 83.3338 trillion won (80% margin, +38% QoQ, +632% YoY), net profit 39.7756 trillion won (38% margin, down 58% from Q2's 93.9226 trillion won). Basic EPS 54,773 won, diluted 54,454 won. The gap between operating and net profit came from a 32.60 trillion won net finance expense, including a 22.92 trillion won valuation loss on financial instruments (instrument not named in the part of the note read) and 12.06 trillion won of FX losses; income tax was 10.93 trillion won. Against FnGuide consensus, results were mixed: revenue (vs 98.23 trillion won) and operating profit (vs 76.96 trillion won) beat, but net profit missed the 61.29 trillion won forecast, so the EPS miss sits below the operating line. Shares rose 10.89% to 1,487,000 won that day. Net cash was 98.7 trillion won at quarter-end. On 28 October the company also announced about 100 trillion won of planned FY2026 shareholder returns, a 20,000 won Q3 dividend (half special, from Kioxia investment gains) and a new buyback of 14.92 million shares (about 20.0 trillion won) from 29 October 2026 to 28 January 2027.

Q3 2026 (9M to 30 September 2026): Relative to FY2025 annual figures, the unaudited Q3 2026 interim report shows a much larger earnings base (quarterly revenue above 100 trillion won at an 80% operating margin) and net profit that swings heavily with investment valuation gains and losses, so annual net-profit figures understate both the operating scale and the non-operating volatility.

US District Court N.D. Cal.: Garciaguirre v. Samsung (5:26-cv-06345-NW), private Sherman Act class action alleging DRAM supply-restriction conspiracy since October 2022; joint motion to dismiss denied 14 November 2026, case moves to discovery (not a liability finding)

Korean Ministry of Employment and Labor: 119 OSH Act violations found at Cheongju campus after June 2026 fluorine fires; criminal prosecution to be sought for 28 violations, about KRW 32 million fines for 84 cases and corrective orders; at Icheon, subcontracting approvals for acid handling cancelled and KRW 27.7 million fines imposed
Korean and Chinese authorities: company-disclosed 2025 administrative fines of KRW 2.4 million for environmental/safety breaches plus an RMB 264 thousand environmental fine in China after an incident
Korean authorities: company-disclosed 2024 administrative fines of KRW 9.6 million for environmental/safety breaches
Korean financial regulators reported to be weighing supervisory measures and filing requirements over a possible Nasdaq IPO of subsidiary Solidigm; no sanction found, IPO review discontinued

US ITC Section 337 investigation 337-TA-1492 (Certain NAND and DRAM Memory Chips) instituted on MonolithIC 3D complaint alleging infringement of eight 3D-stacked-memory patents and seeking an import ban; no initial determination
Netlist patent litigation (ITC, W.D. Tex., PTAB) since 2016 ended by cross-licence settlement under which SK hynix pays royalties
US Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit affirmed dismissal of the DRAM II indirect-purchaser antitrust class action alleging 2016-2018 production restraint
China SAMR officials visited SK hynix's China offices in an inquiry into DRAM pricing; no published decision or penalty found (outcome unknown)
European Commission DRAM cartel settlement decision: Hynix fined about EUR 51.5 million for a 1998-2002 price-fixing cartel
US DOJ Antitrust Division: Hynix Semiconductor agreed to plead guilty to a felony DRAM price-fixing conspiracy (1999-2002) and pay a $185 million criminal fine
